adjudication.rationale: In `GoogleCalendarService.updateEvent`, the new fallback is `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the only time the `.find` branch runs), it searches for `cal.externalId === undefined/null`, which will almost always return `undefined` and no longer falls back to any destination calendar (previously it fell back to `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` when it was a single object). The same tautology appears in `deleteEvent`'s `calendarId` calculation. This is a concrete behavior regression introduced by the diff; whether `calendarId` ultimately becomes `undefined` at the API call site depends on later code not shown in the snippet, but the fallback logic itself is clearly broken in the diff.
